articles.title: Clinical Outcomes and Risk Factor Analysis of Ocular Surface Disorders in Rural Eastern India: A Cross-Sectional Study
articles.abstract: Background: Ocular surface disorders represent a significant burden of preventable blindness in rural communities. Methods: A observational study was conducted at JMN Medical College and Hospital evaluating 350 patients presenting with ocular surface inflammation. Results: Corneal dystrophies and severe dry eye disease were strongly correlated with occupational dust exposure and lack of protective eye wear. Conclusion: Targeted educational campaigns and protective measures are crucial in lowering morbidity.

articles.title: Epidemiological Trends and Prevention Strategies for Non-Communicable Diseases in Sub-Himalayan Districts
articles.abstract: Non-communicable diseases (NCDs) such as hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and cardiovascular conditions are escalating in rural and semi-urban populations. This comprehensive review synthesizes local health survey data across Nadia district to outline community-level interventions.

articles.title: Assessment of Pediatric Nutrition and Micronutrient Deficiencies in Primary Care Settings
articles.abstract: Micronutrient deficiencies impair pediatric growth and cognitive development. This study measured iron, vitamin D, and zinc serum levels among 200 pediatric patients attending outpatient clinics, highlighting actionable supplementation protocols.

articles.title: Rare Presentation of Atypical Anatomical Variation in Renal Vasculature: A Cadaveric Dissection and Clinical Report
articles.abstract: Anatomical variations of the renal artery and vein carry immense surgical significance during nephrectomies and transplant procedures. We present a rare cadaveric finding of an accessory renal artery originating directly from the abdominal aorta superior to the main branch.
